title: Workmanship Warranty Claims under Reconstruction Contracts
content:
**Warranty clause.** The Reconstruction contract must be in substantially complete, final invoiced or closed status when a warranty defect is reported. A defect is covered only when it is reported no later than the warranty term after substantial completion was recorded on the contract. The warranty term is counted in calendar months from the substantial completion date to the same day of the month that many months later, or to the last day of that month when it has no such day, and a defect reported on that end date is in time. A reported defect is inspected within the tier's warranty inspection business days. The inspection finds covered defect when the item is workmanship the company performed and is repaired at no charge, and not covered when it is wear, owner damage, owner-supplied material on tiers whose warranty does not cover it, or work the company did not perform; a not-covered finding carries the tier's warranty trip charge. A report after the warranty term is not inspected under warranty and is handed to a human representative as not covered by policy.

## Reading the clause

- **Status**: taken from the contract record when the report is made; substantially complete, final invoiced and closed contracts may report a defect.
- **Clock**: starts from the substantial completion date on the contract record.
- **End date**: the same day of the month, the warranty term's number of months later; when that month has no such day, the last day of that month.
- **Boundary**: a report on the end date is in time; a report on any later day is not.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Substantial completion date | Term | End date | Report on the end date | Report the next day |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| the 14th of a month | 12 months | the 14th of the same month one year later | in time | after the term |
| the 31st of a month | 12 months, ending in a month with 30 days | the 30th of that month | in time | after the term |

## Inspection findings

| Finding | When | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| Covered defect | workmanship the company performed | repaired at no charge |
| Not covered | wear, owner damage, owner-supplied material on a tier whose warranty does not cover it, or work the company did not perform | the tier's warranty trip charge |
